issues.body: `_assemble_opus5` still computes `answered = bool(hdr)`. Because `_parse_rate_headers` retains `anthropic-ratelimit-unified-status`, a completed response containing only `status: allowed` is considered authoritative even though it provides no utilization evidence. `_premium_window` returns `None`, the persisted `known_window` is not re-declared, and healthy base-window headroom can admit opus5. The recovery test uses `base_only`, which includes 5h and 7d utilization, so it still does not exercise the status-only shape identified in the prior round.
issues.fix_hint: Only clear remembered premium-window state when the response contains explicit, validated utilization evidence sufficient to be authoritative. Otherwise retain the known window without utilization so admission refuses. Add a cross-tick test whose next response contains only `anthropic-ratelimit-unified-status` and assert that the known window survives and opus5 admission is false.
issues.title: Status-only responses still erase a proven bucket and fail open

issues.body: `_limits_line` still emits a line only when at least one truthy `LIMIT_KEYS` value exists, and `persist_limits` still skips the account when that function returns `None`. Therefore an authoritative response with utilization/status headers but no `*-limit` values cannot replace an old catalog line containing `opus5_premium_window`; the stale token remains and is reloaded on a later tick. The cross-tick helper continues to inject `5h_limit=10`, masking this production case.
issues.fix_hint: Persist an explicit cleared limits observation for a successfully and authoritatively probed opus5 account even when no other persisted values remain, while distinguishing an absent or failed usage entry. Add a three-tick production-path test: persist a discovered bucket; process an authoritative base-only response with no limit headers and verify the catalog token is removed; then fail the next probe and verify the stale window is not resurrected.
issues.title: Bucket removal still is not durable when no limit values remain

verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Request changes: both round-4 defects remain at the same severities. A status-only unified response is still treated as authoritative and clears a previously proven premium window, reopening opus5 admission without readable utilization evidence. Separately, an authoritative observation with no remaining persisted limit values still produces no replacement line, so a removed bucket remains stale in the account catalog and can be resurrected after a later failed probe. The new tests continue to avoid both decisive production shapes. Progress is therefore stagnant.
